criteria.matches_direction: Fresh exposed four-spoke wheel, enclosed supported crankcase, rear horizontal cylinder and low control cabinet. Exact existing component coordinates determine arrangement rather than perspective proportions.
criteria.geometry_uvs: Native Java cuboids/45-degree corners and Gecko wheel exported. One 128 atlas composed of native 32 tiles; explicit per-face UVs. Wheel swept radius under 15 units at height30 clears bed top8 by over7 units; shaft and cylinder axes perpendicular.
criteria.material_consistency: Shared master lightened for Photon after first runtime review, reduced speckle contrast. Brass/dial composition preserved. Existing casing/copper slabs retain active pack materials.
criteria.assembly_interfaces: Separate controller, cylinder and flywheel models correspond to current recipe pieces; fuel/oil flanges meet both side block boundaries and front corners stay empty. Static/full wheel is available for guides/items.
criteria.animation_states: Native 1.5-second whole-wheel loop; reviewed 0/22.5/45-degree poses. No external rod crossing the wheel. Server work only controls animation rate. Startup flame remains localized and is checked in-game.
criteria.native_size_readability: Large open rim, light dial and distinct brass service ports survive distance. Inventory scale and Photon lighting require the next runtime review.
